Reference / config/environment

config/environment#

Settings read from environment variables, each bound to a key.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let settings = EnvironmentSettings(
    environment: Environment(),
    names: [EnvironmentBinding(name: "APP_PORT", key: SettingKey("server", "port"))],
    source: SettingSource(kind: SettingSourceKind.environment, name: "environment"),
);

Description#

Settings read from environment variables, each bound to a key.

Only the variables that are bound are read.
